title: Surreal Cosmic Collage
description: A surreal painting divided into multiple distinct scenes. The top features a futuristic city with glowing highways at sunset, floating planets, and a large translucent sphere containing a bright white glowing square. A woman's face with blue skin and golden eyes appears in the upper right. The bottom left shows a vibrant green wolf-like creature with black eyes surrounded by pink flowers. The bottom right depicts a small boat with two figures on calm water at sunset, with a large portrait of a cartoonish older man in a green suit positioned centrally below the glowing square.
prompt: Highly detailed surreal painting featuring a complex collage of scenes: upper left shows a cyberpunk city highway at sunset with floating spheres, center has a large blue planet and a blinding white glowing square portal, upper right a translucent blue woman's face with golden eyes, lower left a bright green wolf creature with pink flowers, lower right a lone boat on water at sunset with orange clouds, and a central circular portrait of a cartoonish middle-aged man with exaggerated features wearing a green outfit, all blended together in a dreamlike cosmic composition.
